question:
How did the Dragon Sword Reid get its name? Also, what is the name of the sword that Wilhelm uses?

Note: We could not find the original question tweet of this Q&A, so this question is hypothetical and represents what may have been asked.
answer:
It may simply have been given that name because the first Sword Saint used it.

The name of the Divine Sword that Wilhelm wielded when he was young, and that Heinkel currently possesses, is called “Astrea.”
